name: Recovery Eval Multi-Seed (5-seed × 3 conditions)
description: 将recovery eval从seed=42扩展至全部5个seed (42/0/123/1/7)，覆盖V/T/R三条件。 每条件47 tasks × 4 operators (P1/P2/C1/C4) round-robin注入。验证D041 resilience-not-recovery发现的跨seed稳定性。~15 GPU-h，需先retrain seed=0/123 checkpoints。

tables.name: Per-Operator TaxEI−Vanilla Δ: Seed=42 vs 5-Seed
tables.content:
| Operator            | Locality | Seed=42 Δ | 5s Mean Δ | 5s SD   | Fisher p |
|---------------------|:--------:|:---------:|:---------:|:-------:|:--------:|
| C4_obs_masking      | Local    | +9.1pp    | +1.8pp    | 12.5pp  | 0.71     |
| P1_step_order_swap  | Mixed    |  0.0pp    | −1.2pp    | 10.8pp  | 0.82     |
| C1_context_trunc    | Global   | −8.3pp    | −3.4pp    | 11.2pp  | 0.49     |
| P2_subgoal_deletion | Global   | −8.3pp    | −4.1pp    | 13.1pp  | 0.38     |

analysis:
5-seed recovery eval的aggregate finding（recovery≈clean rate）是paper的strongest confirmatory result——不依赖p-value而是qualitative pattern match。但per-operator gradient从Results正文降级至Appendix。Reviewer会accept "resilience not recovery" 作为valid finding但不accept per-operator作为stand-alone claim。This experiment changes paper structure: Table 3 (per-operator) moves to Appendix B, replaced by a compact "recovery≈clean" comparison table in main text.


Median档核心参数recovery_clean_rate_match_pp=[0.0, 2.0]。5-seed recovery eval 确认D041的resilience-not-recovery pattern：每条件recovery rate与clean eval rate 偏差<1pp（V: 67.1 vs 67.3=-0.2pp; T: 57.4 vs 58.3=-0.9pp; R: 57.9 vs 58.3=-0.4pp）。 模型通过任务完成能力被动忽略eval-time perturbation而非主动检测修正—— recovery rate本质上就是clean task completion rate在noisy evaluation下的表现。 Detection rate维持0%（Qwen架构在任何seed/条件下都不产生显式error flagging）。
Per-operator patterns是关键降级点：seed=42中C4+9.1pp的"优势"基于N=11单个task flip(6→7/11)，5-seed聚合后collapse至+1.8pp(Fisher p=0.71 NS)。P2保持weak negative direction(-4.1pp)但同样NS。整个local/global gradient从confirmatory 降级为"directional observation consistent with error cascading hypothesis, requiring >200-task benchmarks for per-operator claims"。
这个实验的统计结构：5 seeds × 47 tasks = 235 episodes/condition for aggregate recovery claim (adequate power for ~10pp effect)，但per-operator仅~55-60 episodes (grossly underpowered for ~5pp operator-level effects)。Median档reviewer会accept aggregate resilience finding但要求per-operator移至Appendix。

name: LLaMA-3.1-8B Cross-Model Replication (3-seed)
description: 在LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct上复制核心实验：3 seeds (42/0/123) × 3条件 (V/T/R)。 同训练数据、LoRA配置(rank=16, α=32)、eval protocol。验证TaxEI instability 是否跨architecture成立。~36 GPU-h。
analysis:
LLaMA replication是median档的关键升级——将finding从"single-model negative result" 升级为"cross-model evidence"——但3-seed limitation使其只能是preliminary。 Direction consistency（TaxEI unstable across both models）是可claim的； magnitude consistency不可claim（Qwen consistent -9pp vs LLaMA intermittent -3.6pp）。
最大reviewer risk是detection rate差异：如果LLaMA produces 27% detection而Qwen 0%， reviewer会argue the models learn fundamentally different representations from same data， undermining "cross-model" claim的validity。Counter：detection doesn't improve recovery (LLaMA TaxEI detection 30% but recovery 69.5% ≈ vanilla 73.1%)，so detection is orthogonal to the stability finding。
Paper claim wording必须是："Structured error injection destabilizes training on both Qwen3-8B (consistent harm, 5-seed) and LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct (intermittent catastrophic failure, 3-seed preliminary), while random injection remains stable across both architectures."


Median档cross_model_taxei_sd_ratio=[3.5, 4.5]，catastrophic_seed_fraction=[0.2, 0.33]。
TaxEI SD=8.6pp vs Random SD=2.1pp → ratio=4.1×，落在区间中间。这个ratio由 single catastrophic seed(s123)驱动：s123 recovery=59.6%（vs vanilla 70.2%=-10.6pp， vs random 78.7%=-19.1pp），而s42/s0均=74.5%（与vanilla持平）。Pattern mirrors Qwen 的catastrophic seed现象但表现形式不同：Qwen是consistent degradation（所有5个seed 都低于vanilla），LLaMA是intermittent catastrophe（2/3 neutral, 1/3 catastrophic）。
Reviewer challenge点：(1)"n=3的SD estimate有极宽CI——单个outlier就能创造4× ratio"。 这是valid的——remove s123后TaxEI SD=0pp。但counter-argument是catastrophic seed 本身就是structured injection的核心failure mode。(2)"LLaMA detection rate 27% vs Qwen 0%——不同architecture在学不同的东西，cross-model comparison的前提被undermined。" 这需要在paper中讨论为architecture-dependent behavior。(3)"3 seeds on second model is preliminary at best。1/3=33% catastrophic could be 0/10 with more seeds。"
Random在LLaMA上mildly beneficial(76.6%>vanilla 73.1%,+3.5pp)——与Qwen(Random= Vanilla degraded)形成对比。这支持"unstructured noise is benign-to-helpful"但也 表明effect magnitude是model-dependent。Paper必须从"cross-architecture confirmation" 降级为"preliminary evidence on two architectures suggesting direction consistency"。
Detection rate差异（LLaMA ~27% vs Qwen 0%）是unexpected finding。LLaMA-3.1的 instruction-following tendency更强，可能使其more likely to verbalize error awareness 即使这种awareness doesn't translate to improved recovery。这实际上strengthens "detection ≠ recovery"的argument但需要careful framing。

name: Scale Ablation (25K–50K trajectories)
description: 将训练数据从~500成功轨迹(4,358 clean samples)扩展至~2,500轨迹(~22K clean samples)， 训练V/T/R三条件(3-seed each)。测试TaxEI failure是否primarily due to data scale。 ~$44 API + ~54 GPU-h (3-seed×3 conditions with DDP)。
analysis:
Scale ablation在median档是partial mitigation。Gap减少29%但persist——足以让reviewer 同时argue "scale matters" AND "structure matters"。Paper需要honest framing： "Increasing data 5× narrows the penalty from 9pp to 6.4pp and eliminates catastrophic seeds, indicating data volume is a contributing factor. The residual gap and ALFWorld's diversity ceiling suggest task structure as a co-dominant factor." 这是比"task structure is the primary factor"弱的claim，但对median档reviewer可接受。


Median档预测scale-up narrows gap但不eliminate。核心逻辑：
(1) Vanilla受益最稳定(67.3→71.2%,+3.9pp)：更多clean data直接improve task completion， 无conflicting signals。接近ALFWorld的performance ceiling (~75-80% for 8B models)。
(2) TaxEI gap从-9.0pp缩小至-6.4pp(reduction 29%)：更多data提供更robust的clean signal base，partially buffering against injection noise。但fundamental conflict (structured error patterns vs clean trajectories创造contradictory gradients)不因 data volume消失——P2_SubGoalDeletion在任何scale下都会teach "skip steps is OK" 然后clean data teach "don't skip steps"。
(3) Random gap缩小更多(-9.0→-4.9pp, reduction 46%)：random noise at scale tends to average out(law of large numbers)，而structured patterns maintain systematic bias。这一差异支持"structured > random for harm"的claim。
(4) Catastrophic seed fraction降至0%：5× more data stabilize training dynamics， eliminating the bimodal seed distribution。Training lottery range从19-23pp降至~12pp。 这是data scale的genuine positive effect——与"task structure causes the gap"不矛盾， 因为stability和mean performance是可分离的维度。
(5) Cohen's d从1.58降至1.05(仍large但approaching medium)，Welch t=0.065(NS)。 在median档这意味着：effect real but smaller at scale, still insufficient stat power。
(6) ALFWorld diversity ceiling：2,500 trajectories ÷ 134 unique tasks = ~19 repetitions/task。 PALADIN trains on thousands of unique API patterns。Our "scale-up" is actually "repetition-up"——Reviewer会correctly identify这个distinction。
Reviewer典型response："The gap narrows 29% at 5× scale, suggesting data volume IS a contributing factor. You cannot claim task structure is the 'primary' cause without matching PALADIN's diversity." Median档paper降级claim为："Data scale contributes to the failure (29% gap reduction at 5×) but does not fully account for it. The residual 6.4pp gap, combined with ALFWorld's 134-task diversity ceiling, points to task-structural differences as a co-dominant factor."

name: Recovery Prompting (Few-Shot In-Context)
description: Eval时为每个condition提供2/4个in-context recovery examples（展示error→detection→ correction序列），测试few-shot能否isolate recovery knowledge vs training signal。 如果V/T/R equally benefit，说明recovery能力来自ICL而非SFT。Seed=42, 47 tasks。
analysis:
Recovery prompting是clean control but在median档不改变paper narrative。 它confirms D041 from a different angle。Paper allocation：Discussion section 1段，"In-context recovery examples provide comparable improvement across all conditions (ANOVA NS), confirming that error injection training does not create latent recovery capacity that can be unlocked by prompting."


Median档预测few-shot prompting universally提升所有条件，无条件间差异。
(1) ICL provides "what recovery looks like" template——是LLM的general能力， 与SFT training regime无关。V/T/R同等受益(+4-6pp)证明SFT期间的error injection 没有创造任何可被ICL amplify的recovery capability。若TaxEI训练真的teach了latent recovery ability，应该看到TaxEI从few-shot中disproportionately benefit（additive effect: SFT recovery knowledge + ICL recovery template = super-additive）。 实际结果：TaxEI improvement = Vanilla improvement = ~6.4pp → zero SFT contribution。
(2) Detection rate从0%→~15%：ICL examples provide detection template，LLM能 模仿format但不reliable执行。这与SFT 0% detection对比：即使explicit error tag exposure during SFT不teach detection，但4个in-context examples partially do。 暗示SFT signal在fine-tuning过程中被downstream pattern corruption覆盖，而ICL operates at a more superficial level that preserves detection formatting。
(3) 4-shot improvement ~5pp mean modest——远低于closing gap to vanilla clean(67.3%)。 Even with explicit recovery templates，embodied planning的cascading error nature 使genuine recovery fundamentally hard。Models can detect ~15% of errors and still fail to recover from most of them。
(4) Reviewer视为"expected given resilience finding"——如果D041已confirmed resilience-not-recovery，few-shot control是belt-and-suspenders。Value在于 completeness而非novelty。Paper中应放Discussion短段而非main result。

name: Per-Operator Deep Dive (Multi-Seed)
description: 利用recovery-eval-multiseed的5-seed数据，对4个operator分别计算multi-seed TaxEI−Vanilla recovery delta。验证seed=42的local/global gradient是否replicate。
analysis:
Per-operator deep dive confirms this analysis is exploratory-only。对paper的impact minimal——main claims不依赖per-operator patterns。Appendix B一页足够。关键句： "While the directional pattern (local operators neutral, global operators harmful) is consistent with our error cascading hypothesis, per-operator effects are not statistically distinguishable from noise at N≈57 per cell. Benchmarks with >200 diverse tasks are needed for per-operator claims."


Median档per-operator gradient在multi-seed后collapse to noise。
(1) Seed=42的C4=+9.1pp基于11个episodes中1个flip(6→7)——本质上是coin flip。 5-seed聚合后~57 episodes/operator/condition给每个operator ~±8-13pp的SD。 C4的mean从+9.1→+1.8pp，Fisher p=0.71——signal消失在variance中。
(2) Direction weakly preserved：local operators(C4)仍slightly positive(+1.8pp)， global operators(C1,P2)仍negative(−3.4, −4.1pp)。但magnitude减小~70%，且 Spearman rank correlation(n=4)完全uninformative(p=0.42)。
(3) P2(sub_goal_deletion)保持最negative(−4.1pp)——合理因为sub-goal deletion是 most globally cascading的operator。但Fisher p=0.38 NS，无法distinguish from noise。
(4) 这个实验的value是将per-operator analysis从"interesting pattern"降级为 "hypothesis for future work with larger benchmarks"。Reviewer会agree这个降级。 Paper中从Results Table移至Appendix exploratory analysis。

name: Scale-Up Data Collection (500→2500 Trajectories)
description: GPT-5.2 trajectory collection从501扩展至~2,500成功轨迹。分阶段：先1,000 check trend再决定2,500。ALFWorld diversity ceiling ~134 unique tasks。~$44 API cost。
analysis:
Scale-up data是scale-ablation的prerequisite，结果一致。Diminishing returns 是key visual——logarithmic fit shows gap never reaches zero within any feasible ALFWorld scale。This supports task-structure argument but must be presented as "suggestive projection" not "proof"。
Paper allocation：Results section一段 + diminishing returns figure。Limitation section承认"We cannot fully disentangle data scale from task structure within a single benchmark. Cross-benchmark validation (e.g., ToolBench replication of TaxEI) would provide stronger evidence but requires substantial engineering effort."

Scale-up data collection在median档是feasibility + diminishing returns story。
(1) Collection feasibility confirmed：70% success rate stable（与initial 501-traj collection一致），cost linear($8.86/500≈$44/2500)。无technical barrier。
(2) Phase 1 (1,000-traj) gap已经narrow(9.0→7.1pp)，phase 2 (2,500) further narrow(7.1→6.4pp)——clear diminishing returns。500→1000 gains 1.9pp， 1000→2500 only 0.7pp。Extrapolating logarithmically，5000 traj would yield ~5.5pp gap——仍non-zero。
(3) ALFWorld diversity ceiling是fundamental：134 unique tasks × 18.7 repetitions = pure repetition augmentation。PALADIN's advantage可能是task diversity (thousands of unique API call patterns)而非volume。Paper应explicit state： "Within ALFWorld's 134-task diversity ceiling, data scale reduction accounts for ~29% of the injection penalty. The remaining gap likely reflects task-structural differences that cannot be resolved by repetition-based scaling."
(4) 训练resource significant(54 GPU-h total for 3s×3c)但feasible with 4×5090。 Question is ROI：这个experiment对reviewer的说服力是moderate——它addresses concern #10 partially but opens the door for "you need to scale to 50K" counter-argument。
(5) Median档reviewer response：将scale-up result视为evidence for mixed causation (both scale and structure contribute)而非clean separation。这是reasonable——我们 不能fully disentangle scale from structure within a single benchmark。
